title: FFI Export Plan
description: Declares the safety-relevant shape of a Rust cdylib's extern "C" exports and the TypeScript/Bun loader that calls them, for deterministic auditing against the rust-kernel-ffi quality gates.

exports.description: Every #[no_mangle] extern "C" function exposed by the cdylib.

name.description: The exported symbol name, e.g. pd_macaroon_verify_json.

hasCatchUnwindOrPanicAbort.description: True if the export body is wrapped in std::panic::catch_unwind and/or the crate builds with panic = "abort".

inputGuards.description: Which of the five input guards are present before any parsing/logic runs.

null.description: Null-pointer check on every raw pointer argument.

bound.description: len > BOUND rejected to cap allocation/parse size.

parse.description: serde_json::from_str (or equivalent) validated, sentinel on failure.

returnsSentinelOnFailure.description: The export returns a clear sentinel (null / false / negative code) on every failure path, rather than crashing or returning ambiguous output.

handsOutString.description: True if this export returns a heap-allocated CString via into_raw().

hasMatchingFreeFn.description: True if a paired #[no_mangle] free function exists for strings handed out by this export. Irrelevant (should be false) when handsOutString is false.

passesRustStructAcrossBoundary.description: True if this export passes a Rust struct/enum by value or reference across the FFI boundary instead of primitives or a *const c_char JSON payload. Should be false.

constantTimeCompareForMacs.description: True only if every MAC/tag comparison in the crate uses a full-length fold-XOR compare with no early return on the first differing byte.

crateType.description: Cargo.toml crate-type. Should be ["rlib", "cdylib"] so the core is unit-tested as an rlib and shipped as a dylib.

loaderDegradesGracefully.description: True if the TS/Bun koffi loader captures a load failure and returns null (falling back to a pure-TS path) instead of throwing/crashing the host when the dylib is absent.

testedUnderRealRuntime.description: True if the FFI call path has been exercised under the actual host runtime (e.g. the bun daemon), not only a unit-test harness like jest.
